name: Google Chrome DevContainer
postStartCommand: docker volume create chrome-config >/dev/null; docker rm -f chrome 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name=chrome --restart=always -p 8080:3000 -v chrome-config:/config -e AUTO_LOGIN=true -e SUBFOLDER=/ -e CHROME_CLI="--disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --no-sandbox" --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size=4gb ghcr.io/linuxserver/chrome:latest
